violations.description: Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed using same pair of single-use gloves for more than one task. Observed kitchen employee handle raw hamburger using the same gloves he than cut a quesadilla with. Gloves need to be changed between tasks.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. A package of raw, cut, whole meat was stored next to a package of sausage in the glass door reach in cooler--Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. Raw bacon in the package was stored next to hot dogs and cheese. Eggs removed from the original container was stored next to packaged cheese in the glass door reach in cooler.
